title: Create sentiment insights report endpoint
description: Build a new endpoint /sentiment/{symbol}/insights that aggregates news from diverse sources and provides actionable intelligence beyond velocity metrics. Should include: theme extraction, source diversity analysis, sentiment trend patterns, anomaly detection, and actionable recommendations.

title: Extract key themes from aggregated news text
description: Use NLP techniques to extract recurring themes, keywords, and topics from the collected news. Could use TF-IDF or simple keyword extraction.

title: Build source diversity metrics
description: Calculate metrics for source coverage: number of unique sources, geographic diversity, source type distribution (social/news/market data), agreement/disagreement between sources.

title: Detect sentiment anomalies and trends
description: Identify sudden sentiment shifts, unusual patterns, divergence between sources. Include trend direction (improving/deteriorating) and confidence intervals.

title: Generate actionable recommendations
description: Based on sentiment analysis, provide clear trading signals or alerts: 'high confidence bullish', 'mixed signals', 'negative trend accelerating', etc.

title: Add entry reservation to prevent TOCTOU race in TrendStrategy
description: Per-symbol goroutines can simultaneously pass CanEnter() checks and then both call RegisterPosition(), exceeding MaxOpenPositions or correlation limits. Fix: Add TryReserveEntry(symbol, side) that atomically checks constraints and inserts a pending record. On order success: RegisterPosition overwrites pending. On order failure: CancelReservation removes pending.

title: Add market-wide sentiment endpoint for general crypto news
description: Implement /sentiment/market endpoint that fetches general crypto market news without symbol filtering. This provides market regime context (fear/greed), captures regulatory and institutional news, and reduces duplicate API calls. Includes deduplication logic to avoid processing the same news multiple times across symbols.

title: Add 7-day baseline metrics to insights endpoint
description: Extend insights with actionable 7-day relative metrics: sentiment_zscore_7d, mentions_zscore_7d, sentiment_percentile_7d, momentum_6h/24h, attention_momentum. These enable better trading decisions based on historical context.

title: Add realized-vol features to regime model (8 features)
description: Add atrp_14 and range_sma_6 to regime classifier features (6->8). Create features_regime_v2.py, update Go builder, retrain, compare 6 vs 8 features

title: Add Telegram channel fetcher with flood limit handling
description: Implement Telethon-based fetcher for Telegram public channels as a crypto news source. Needs exponential backoff retry logic for message fetching to handle Telegram flood limits. Review MTProto connection code for security best practices and rate limiting.

title: Add web dashboard for sentiment news visualization
description: Create simple web interface at sentiment/dashboard that displays top news from each source with FinBERT predictions. Features: selectable count (5/10/15), show source, title, sentiment scores, prediction label, confidence. Should work standalone or as part of sentiment server.

title: Fetch 1H candle + funding data for all 4 symbols (2020-02 to 2026-02)
Refactor fetchers from symbol-specific to general market fetching with post-processing categorization
Ingest 1H candles + funding into training_1h.db
Fix hourly sentiment persistence to represent true hourly buckets
description: Currently hourly sentiment rows store 24h rolling counts and all-posts aggregates instead of hour-specific data. This breaks historical trend analysis. Need to: 1) Compute mentions_count for that specific hour, 2) Compute scores from posts in that hour only, 3) Use hour-truncated timestamps for bucketing.

title: Add Grafana dashboard for Prometheus metrics
description: Create a Grafana dashboard template for the bot's Prometheus metrics. Should visualize: equity curve, PnL (realized/unrealized), open positions, trade history, win rate, drawdown, order execution time, and per-symbol sentiment scores. Include JSON export for easy import.

title: Add Telegram /status command for bot health check
description:
Add a /status command to Telegram bot that returns:
- Bot uptime
- Current mode (paper/live)
- Open positions count
- Daily PnL
- Candles received per symbol
- Last candle timestamp per symbol
- WebSocket connection status
- Memory usage

Implementation in internal/alerts/telegram.go

title: Backfill hourly (not just daily) sentiment on first run
description: Current backfill only writes daily aggregates but /insights reads hourly data, causing insufficient historical context on first run. Need to populate hourly buckets during backfill.

title: Epic: Improve FinBERT for crypto sentiment
description: Current ProsusAI/finbert is trained on traditional financial text (Reuters), not crypto. Two approaches: (1) Quick win: swap to burakutf/finetuned-finbert-crypto, a pre-trained crypto FinBERT. (2) Long-term: fine-tune our own model on data collected from our fetchers. Both require careful label mapping since ProsusAI uses [positive,negative,neutral] while crypto model uses [negative,neutral,positive].

title: Swap to burakutf/finetuned-finbert-crypto model
description: Quick win: Replace ProsusAI/finbert with burakutf/finetuned-finbert-crypto. This model is already fine-tuned on crypto news/tweets. CRITICAL: label mapping differs - crypto model uses {0:negative, 1:neutral, 2:positive} while current code assumes {0:positive, 1:negative, 2:neutral}. Must fix label indices in finbert.py analyze() method. Also add config toggle to switch between models.

title: Benchmark ProsusAI vs crypto FinBERT on real fetcher data
description: Run both models side-by-side on recent crypto news from our fetchers (CryptoPanic, NewsAPI, Finnhub). Compare predictions on crypto-specific terms like 'moon', 'pump', 'rug pull', 'WAGMI', 'diamond hands'. Output a comparison report showing where they disagree.

title: Build crypto news labeling pipeline for future fine-tuning
description: Create a pipeline that: (1) Stores raw news text from fetchers alongside FinBERT predictions in a new SQLite table, (2) Uses price movement after news as weak supervision labels (if BTC goes up 2% in 4h after bullish news = correct prediction), (3) Accumulates labeled data over time for future fine-tuning. Schema: id, text, source, symbol, predicted_label, predicted_confidence, price_at_prediction, price_4h_later, actual_label (from price movement).

title: Fine-tune FinBERT on accumulated crypto data
description: Once we have 5000+ labeled samples from the labeling pipeline, fine-tune ProsusAI/finbert on our own crypto dataset. Training params: lr=2e-5, epochs=3, batch_size=16, max_seq_length=256. Use 80/10/10 train/val/test split. Must validate: train vs test accuracy gap < 5% (avoid overfitting like v1 XGBoost). Save model to ml/models/finbert_crypto_v1/. Add evaluation script comparing against base model.

title: Directional split for regime classifier (LONG vs SHORT)
description: Train separate regime models for LONG vs SHORT breakouts. Modify labeler/trainer to split by side, compare AUC. Create ml/regime/train_regime_directional.py

title: Fix WebSocket reconnection race conditions
description: Oracle identified race conditions in binance.go WebSocket handling: 1) addSubscriptionAndReconnect closes conn but existing readLoop can still trigger reconnectWithBackoff while ensureConnected is dialing. 2) No 'connection generation' tracking - old read loops can reconnect after newer conn is active. 3) Multiple goroutines can call ensureConnected() concurrently. Fix: Add connection generation tracking and serialize connection establishment.

title: Improve binance kline parsing to handle ParseFloat errors
description: Current parseKlineMessage() silently ignores ParseFloat errors with blank identifier. This can cause zero prices/volumes to be passed to indicators/strategy, potentially causing bad signals. Should propagate parse errors or at minimum log and skip the candle.

title: Train regime classifier + vol predictor on 1H data and compare to 4H results
Plan D Improvements: Whipsaw Defense, Dynamic Chandelier, Correlation Guard, Volatility Scalar, Breakout Retest
description: Parent epic for Plan D improvements documented in docs/PLAN_D_IMPROVEMENT.md. Contains 5 patches to improve drawdown, profit retention, and risk management.

title: Patch 1: Whipsaw Defense - Entry Filter
description:
Reduce false breakouts by filtering weak closes.

**Logic:**
- Require breakout candle to be bullish (Close > Open) - prevents entering on 'Shooting Star' candles
- Add Bandwidth volatility check: don't enter if BB Bandwidth is in bottom 10th percentile (dead market)

**Implementation:**
- Modify OnBar() in internal/strategy/trend.go
- Add is_green_candle check: breakout candle must have Close > Open
- Add BB Bandwidth filter: vol_ok = bb_width > rolling_quantile(0.10)

**Files to modify:**
- internal/strategy/trend.go (OnBar function)
- internal/features/indicators.go (add BollingerBandwidth if missing)

**Priority:** HIGH (deploy first batch)

title: Patch 2: Dynamic Chandelier Exit - Profit Locking
description:
Tighten stops as trade becomes profitable to protect unrealized gains.

**Logic:**
- Initial: Stop is 3.0 * ATR from the High
- Level 1 (>2R Profit): Tighten to 2.5 * ATR
- Level 2 (>4R Profit): Tighten to 2.0 * ATR  
- Level 3 (>6R Profit): Tighten to 1.5 * ATR

**Implementation:**
- Modify UpdateTrailingStop() in internal/strategy/trend.go
- Calculate current R-Multiple using: r_multiple = (current_high - entry_price) / initial_risk
- Select ATR multiplier based on R level
- Apply ratchet rule: stop can ONLY move up (never against position)

**Files to modify:**
- internal/strategy/trend.go (UpdateTrailingStop function)

**Priority:** HIGH (deploy first batch)

title: Patch 3: Correlation Guard - Sector-Based Portfolio Risk
description:
Prevent over-exposure to a single sector (e.g., going Long on 4 different L1 coins simultaneously).

**Logic:**
- Maintain SECTOR_MAP: BTC -> 'BTC', ETH/SOL/AVAX/ADA -> 'L1', FET/RNDR/WLD -> 'AI', DOGE/SHIB/PEPE -> 'MEME'
- Rule: Max 1 position per sector
- Rule: Max 3 positions total

**Implementation:**
- Add SECTOR_MAP config or constant
- Add sector checking in canEnterLocked() in internal/strategy/trend.go
- Before entry: check if same sector already has a position

**Files to modify:**
- internal/strategy/trend.go (add sector map, modify canEnterLocked)
- internal/config/config.go (optional: add sector map to config)

**Priority:** HIGH (deploy first batch)

title: Patch 4: Volatility Scalar - Market Regime Sizing
description:
Adjust position size based on Market Regime (not just individual asset volatility).

**Logic:**
- Calculate global 'Market VIX': average ATR% of BTC and ETH
- If Market is Quiet (ATR% < 2%): Scale Size 1.2x (safe to take bigger bets)
- If Market is Violent (ATR% > 5%): Scale Size 0.5x (preserve capital)
- If Market is Normal: Scale Size 1.0x

**Implementation:**
- Add market volatility calculation (average ATR% of BTC/ETH)
- Modify CalculatePositionSize() to accept market volatility scalar
- Apply scalar to base risk percentage

**Files to modify:**
- internal/strategy/trend.go (CalculatePositionSize, add market vol calculation)
- cmd/bot/main.go (calculate and pass market volatility to strategy)

**Priority:** MEDIUM (deploy second batch)

title: Patch 5: Breakout Retest - Split Entry Execution
description:
Improve average entry price by not FOMOing 100% of size at breakout.

**Logic:**
- Market Buy 50% of size immediately
- Place Limit Buy 50% at Entry_Price - (0.5 * ATR)
- If Limit not filled after 3 candles -> Cancel it (trend too strong, just ride the 50%)

**Implementation:**
- Modify handleTrendEntry() in cmd/bot/main.go
- Split order into two parts: immediate market order (50%) and limit order (50%)
- Track pending limit orders and cancel after 3 candles if not filled

**Files to modify:**
- cmd/bot/main.go (handleTrendEntry, add limit order tracking)
- internal/strategy/trend.go (may need to track split entry state)

**Priority:** LOW (optional, only if exchange API supports it easily)
notes: Won't implement - complexity outweighs benefit. Requires: 1) Limit order API support, 2) Order tracking state machine, 3) Candle counting per pending order, 4) Cancellation logic, 5) Partial position registration. Current market orders work fine for 4h timeframe where slippage is minimal.

Currently candles are stored in-memory only, which means the bot loses historical data needed for indicators (ATR, EMAs, Donchian) on restart and must wait for enough candles to accumulate again.

Use Python logging module with configurable levels.

Features: returns_1d/4d/20d, rsi_14, bb_width, adx_14, ema_9_distance, funding_8h_avg, funding_vs_24h_mean, temporal features. Target: binary 1 if price 4 bars ahead > 1.5%. Objective: maximize Sortino ratio. Output best params to opt/results/best_params_{SYMBOL}.yaml. Create scripts/apply_optimized_params.py to merge into config.yaml with diff.
